title: Deposit Refund Schedule Note: Long-Held Slots and the No-Show Fee Offset (In-Person Appointments)
content:
**Note to the deposit refund schedule, In-Person Appointments.** On a missed visit, a sum is added to the no-show fee the refund offsets according to the days the missed slot was held for the patient:

- held **90 days or more**: **25.00** dollars are added to the no-show fee the refund offsets;
- held **60 to 89 days**: **15.00** dollars are added;
- held **fewer than 60 days**: nothing is added.

The days held run up to the scheduled date of the missed visit; the slot is first held for the patient on the booking date shown on the appointment record.

**Pairs across each line (hypothetical holds).**

| Days held | Added |
|---|---|
| 90 | 25.00 dollars |
| 89 | 15.00 dollars |
| 60 | 15.00 dollars |
| 59 | nothing |

*Hypothetical:* a Specialist Consultation booked 2026-05-04 for 2026-07-20, never moved or confirmed, was held 77 days: 15.00 dollars are added.
